intent.goal: Make `verifySession` in src/auth/session.ts return null for an expired session instead of throwing, so callers can treat 'no session' uniformly. Keep the signature unchanged.
Increment `metrics.sessionsExpired` whenever `authenticate` in src/api/handlers.ts sees a request with an expired session.

Invoices must round tax half to even. Make `taxFor` in src/billing/tax.ts round exact halves to the even minor unit, and make `computeTotal` in src/billing/invoice.ts use `taxFor` instead of rounding by itself.

Change `applyDiscounts` in src/billing/discount.ts so that at most one percentage discount (the largest) and one fixed discount (the largest) apply to an invoice. The percentage comes off first, then the fixed amount, and the total discount never exceeds the subtotal.
Write an audit log entry with event "session.expired" whenever a login request (`handleLogin` in src/auth/login.ts) arrives with an expired session. The response must still be the `expired` response.
Add an `x-session-ttl` header to authenticated responses (`withSessionHeaders` in src/api/responses.ts): the whole seconds left before the session expires.
Make `validateProfile` in src/users/profile.ts reject a display name longer than 64 visible characters, reporting the problem on the `displayName` field.

Add `canAccess(roles, resource)` to src/users/roles.ts. It returns true when any of the user's roles is at least the minimum role for the resource. Resources and their minimum roles: "profile" needs viewer, "invoices" needs member, "billing" needs billing, "members" needs admin.
Make `formatMoney` in src/billing/currency.ts respect each currency's number of decimals: yen has none, so 1200 yen is "¥1200", not "¥12.00".
Make `nextInvoiceNumber` in src/billing/invoice.ts restart the sequence at 0001 when `issuedAt` falls in a later calendar year than the previous invoice number.

Count each request that arrives with an expired session against the client's rate limit (`guardRequest` in src/auth/rate-limit.ts), so a client replaying an expired token is eventually turned away. Valid sessions and requests without a session must not be counted.
Enforce the `requireDigit` rule in `checkPasswordPolicy` (src/auth/password.ts): when it is on, a password with no digit gets the "needs_digit" issue. Turn the rule on in `DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY`.

why: formatMoney uses each currency's own number of decimals.

why: Counter in the catch branch: relies on verifySession throwing.
nextInvoiceNumber restarts at 0001 when the year changes.
verifySession returns null for an expired session instead of throwing. Signature unchanged.
applyDiscounts takes the largest percentage and the largest fixed discount only.
checkPasswordPolicy enforces requireDigit, which is now on by default.
Uses the Session type and sessionTtl only, so it is unaffected by t01.
validateProfile rejects display names longer than 64 visible characters.
taxFor rounds half to even; computeTotal uses taxFor.
